labels.alert_unconfirmed_sub: Said in one feed; it is an alert once the next feed says it too
labels.station_none: a plain spot on deck (no stage reported)
labels.sight_gulls_off: Gulls left {ship}: its reporters are late
labels.sight_gulls_back: Gulls back on {ship}: its reporters are live
labels.sight_dark: Lighthouse dark: the host stopped answering this screen
labels.sight_lit: Lighthouse lit: the host answers this screen again
labels.sight_walk_off: {title} to a plain spot (no stage reported)
labels.sound_splash: sound: a splash and a creak
labels.why_merged: the next report changed it first
labels.why_not_drawn: its ship is not drawn on this screen
labels.why_below: that sailor is below decks or on a ship not drawn here
labels.why_waited: it waited a minute for its turn
labels.receipt_harbor: moored in the harbor, sails furled
labels.receipt_anchored: at anchor, sails furled, its lantern dim
labels.receipt_convoy_one: One more ship in the convoy{words}
labels.receipt_horizon_open: No islands ahead: nothing next in the feed
labels.receipt_isle_unknown: (last known, its queue report is old)
labels.receipt_event_dolphins: A longboat is rowing home with dolphins
labels.receipt_replay: Played again on request: the last event
labels.legend_stations: Sailors stand at the station for their stage: chart table (plan), workbench (build), inspection (verify), signal staff (ship), rail (waits on you), barrels (landed); no stage, a plain spot
labels.legend_longboat: A longboat rows a chest home: something landed
labels.legend_dolphins: Dolphins escort it: the first landing in 10 minutes
labels.legend_gulls: Gulls on a ship's yard: its reporters are live; they fly off when it goes late
labels.legend_whale: A whale breaches: a release went live (at most once an hour)
labels.legend_rainbow: A rainbow over a ship: a critical on it cleared (never while another critical is open)
labels.legend_becalmed: Slack sails: work runs on that machine but has gone quiet
labels.legend_fleet: One ship per machine, in a fixed order: the flagship in front, escorts behind; moored with furled sails, idle and well; at anchor with a dim lantern, asleep; past six, a convoy with a count plate
labels.legend_lighthouse: The lighthouse: lit while this screen reaches its host, dark while it hails
labels.legend_islands: Islands on the far horizon: one for each item queued next, nearer and larger as its date comes, a held one in mist, a gate with a beacon; a dotted outline when that queue report is old, fog when its source is silent; none when nothing is queued
labels.legend_windows: Stern windows: one for each lane with an agent to be at; lit when the agent is alive, dark when its session ended or its endpoint is gone, shuttered when the source reports no agent for it or its report is old
labels.legend_sound: Sound, if switched on: two bells for a new call, a splash for a landing, thunder for a critical
labels.keys_deck: Arrows move · Enter opens · Esc goes back
labels.keys_item: Esc goes back · Enter opens a link
labels.say_none: Nothing to say: this needs no answer from you.
labels.copy_select: Selected: copy it by hand. The board sends nothing.
labels.log_board_check: The board shows {board} waiting from {source}; its newest push said {push}:
labels.log_unreadable: The log could not be read.
labels.ev_skew: Its clock is {t} off the host's
labels.item_missing_body: Nothing here has that name now.
labels.item_gone_body: No longer on the board since {t}: answered, finished or dropped.
labels.ship_unknown_body: It may not have reported yet. The board's places are one level up.
labels.chip_runs_out: {who} may run out {in} ({empty}), before the {window} reset {t}
labels.agent_state_gone: gone (its pane or process no longer exists)
labels.skew_note: {name} runs adapter {v}, older than {since}, which {other} already runs ({newer}): {effect}
labels.trust_slowed: {name}: slowed on purpose ({why}), reports about every {t}
labels.pace_line: slowed on purpose to every {t}, normally {n}: {why}
labels.lib_why_not_checked: sync last ran {t} ago; the board cannot tell why
labels.lib_why_waiting: {n} files not in the library, oldest since {t}
labels.lib_why_unknown: the receipt could not be read
labels.agent_gone_act: Nobody is at this work: relaunch its agent or close it, where its source runs.
labels.since_label: What changed since this screen last looked
labels.hint_title_phone: Tap the ship to look inside
labels.hint_body_phone: Or tap a place below. Back comes out again.
labels.key_sc_fleet: Ships: one per machine · furled: idle · dim lantern: asleep
labels.key_sc_livery: Pennant colours: which machine, nothing more. Picked from each machine's id by a fixed rule, so a machine keeps its colour. Never a state.
labels.key_sc_dolphins: Dolphins: the first landing in 10 min
labels.key_sc_windows: Stern windows: an agent at the work
labels.key_never_colour: Every colour comes with a shape or a word.
labels.cap_lighthouse: The lighthouse: this screen reaches its host. Opens the Logbook
labels.cap_lighthouse_dark: The lighthouse is dark: this screen cannot reach its host. Opens the Logbook
labels.cap_gulls: Gulls on {ship}: its reporters are live. Opens the Crow's nest
labels.cap_landing: A longboat: work landed. Opens the Cargo hold
labels.cap_whale: A whale: a release went live. Opens the Chart room
labels.tour_on: Touring the places · any key stops it
labels.signal_fleet: the machines the sources report, the primary source's machine first
labels.signal_stations: each lane's stage, or the step it is on
labels.signal_longboat: work its source reports as landed
labels.signal_rainbow: a critical its source reported that is no longer in its report
labels.signal_dolphins: work its source reports as landed
labels.signal_whale: the version a group has live
labels.signal_becalmed: whether a lane's work is active or quiet
labels.signal_lighthouse: this screen asking its host for the board
labels.signal_islands: the queue each source reports (what is next), and how fresh that report is
labels.signal_windows: each lane's agent state as its source reports it
labels.signal_sound: the sound setting in the host's config
labels.lane_you_what: a call that only you can answer; it is also at the top
labels.lane_att_what: its checks stopped, its worker is gone, or nothing moved for too long
labels.lane_unk_what: its state can't be read now; its last word and age are shown
labels.lane_sup_what: stopped at a review, blocked, or holding a question that the supervising agent answers; the lane says the agent's own name
labels.lane_lane_what: starts when the lane it names lands
labels.lane_paused_what: its worker said it is waiting, and until when if it knows
labels.lane_check_what: tests, review fixes or CI are running for it
labels.lane_done_what: its checks passed: PR ready, merged, or report written
labels.lane_none_what: an older feed sends no lane state: the row's word and sentence come from its structured fields only, never its prose
labels.ls_call_open: Your call is open at the top of the board.
labels.ls_fixing_still: It is still fixing what review found{step}
labels.ls_worker_gone: its worker's pane or process is gone ({t} ago)
labels.ls_worker_gone_alone: Its worker's pane or process is gone ({t} ago).
labels.ls_unreadable: Its state can't be read now
labels.ls_last_word: ; the last thing it said was {what}, {t} ago.
labels.ls_last_word_now: ; the last thing it said was {what}.
labels.ls_gate_owner_unknown: It stopped at a gate, and the record does not say whose answer it waits on.
labels.ls_verb_parked: that it stopped at a gate
labels.ls_gate_stop: Stopped at its {gate} for {who} to decide.
labels.ls_gate_stop_n: Stopped at its {gate} with {n} for {who} to decide.
labels.ls_gate_worker_n: At its {gate} with {n}; its worker decides.
labels.ls_asked_after: , and it has asked {who} a question.
labels.ls_starts_when_plain: Starts when the lane it waits on lands.
labels.ls_worker_busy: Its worker is busy right now.
labels.ls_finished_pr-ready: Checks are green and its PR is ready.
labels.ls_finished_held: Checks are green and its PR is held for merge.
labels.ls_merges_itself: It merges by itself once ready.
labels.row_you_what: only you can move it: a call, or a lane that says it waits for your OK on an open PR
labels.row_stuck_what: live work nobody is moving: it failed, it is blocked, or its worker's session ended
labels.row_unk_what: its state can't be read now; the row says its last news and when
labels.row_work_what: a worker is on it, or its tests or CI are running
labels.row_other_what: a review upstream, a check its supervisor answers, another lane, or a pause on purpose; the sentence says which
labels.steer_unread_one: An instruction from {who} has sat unread for {t}
labels.steer_unread_many: {n} instructions from {who} have sat unread, the oldest for {t}
labels.steer_undelivered_one: An instruction from {who} was never delivered ({t} ago)
labels.steer_undelivered_many: {n} instructions from {who} were never delivered, the oldest {t} ago
labels.steer_busy: ; the worker is busy in a turn.
labels.rs_call: It has a call waiting for your answer.
labels.rs_approval: It says it is waiting for your OK.
labels.rs_approval_pr: It says it is waiting for your OK on PR {pr}.
labels.hk_approval_merged: Old approval: PR {pr} merged, nothing left to approve.
labels.hk_approval_closed: Old approval: PR {pr} was closed without merging, nothing left to approve.
labels.rs_key_stuck: It needs a hand; its feed does not say why.
labels.rs_key_unk: Its state can't be read now.
labels.rs_key_other: It waits on someone else; its feed does not say who.
labels.rs_died_waiting: It was waiting on {who} when its work stopped; nothing newer is recorded.
labels.rs_gone_waiting: It was waiting on {who} when its worker's session ended, {gone} ago.
labels.hk_unread: Old record: its books can't say what it is doing now. Last news {ago} ago: {was}. Not counted as live trouble.
labels.hk_unread_never: Old record: its books can't say what it is doing now, and no news of it is recorded. Not counted as live trouble.
labels.rs_was_failed: a failure, which a newer status may since have replaced
labels.rs_was_other: no word on what it was doing
labels.rs_unknown: Its state can't be read now. Last news {ago} ago.
labels.rs_unknown_never: Its state can't be read now, and no news of it is recorded.
labels.rs_gone: Nobody is on it: its worker's session ended {gone} ago.
labels.rs_gone_pane: Nobody is on it: its worker's pane or process is gone ({gone} ago).
labels.hk_gone_merged: Finished but never closed: PR {pr} merged, and its worker's session ended {gone} ago.
labels.hk_gone_merged_never: Finished but never closed: PR {pr} merged, and its worker's session ended; when is not reported.
labels.rs_failed_closed: It stopped on a failure, and PR {pr} was closed without merging.
labels.rs_done_closed: It says it finished; PR {pr} was closed without merging.
labels.rs_pr_open: Its PR {pr} is waiting on review upstream.
labels.rs_pr_unread: Its PR {pr} is recorded, but its state could not be read.
labels.rs_mate_gate: Stopped at a check for {who} to decide.
labels.rs_mate_capacity: It waits for capacity: a slot or a quota.
labels.rs_mate_quiet: It waits for quiet hours to end.
labels.rs_mate_paused: Paused on purpose by its worker.
labels.rs_mate: It is waiting; its feed does not say on what.
labels.strip_fine_yes: {live} of {total} feeds report; the newest report is {t} old.
labels.strip_fine_not: Not now: {parts} open. When both lists are empty and every feed reports, this tile is the only one lit.
labels.att_unreadable_one: 1 lane on {where} can't be read right now; it shows its last word below.
labels.att_unreadable_many: {n} lanes on {where} can't be read right now; each shows its last word below.
labels.grp_no_goals: No goals are set: lanes are shown by project.
labels.grp_lanes_goals: Lanes, grouped by the goal they serve; lanes with no goal by project
labels.grp_goal_none: no goal set: shown by project
labels.cnt_other: {n} with a word this board does not know
labels.sea_label: The sea, with a caption for every picture
labels.cp_sailor: one lane, standing at its stage
labels.cp_dolphins: the first landing on that ship in 10 min
labels.cp_slack: nothing stirred on its running lanes
labels.cp_windows: a worker is at its lane
labels.key_lanes_head: Every lane is in exactly one of these
